title: Scepsy: Serving Agentic Workflows Using Aggregate LLM Pipelines
authors: Marcel Wagenländer; Otto White; Britannio Jarrett; Pedro Silvestre; Yanda Tao; Guo Li; Huanzhou Zhu; Lluís Vilanova; Peter Pietzuch
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Capacity planning, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agentic workflows compose multiple heterogeneous LLMs and tools whose end-to-end latency is highly variable, yet small-to-medium clusters oversubscribe scarce GPUs and lack workflow-aware GPU allocation. Existing systems either run LLMs in isolation (no workflow awareness) or rely on temporal request scheduling rather than allocating fractional GPU resources jointly across LLMs.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic workflow 結合多種異質 LLM 與工具，端到端延遲高度變異；中小型叢集面對稀缺 GPU 易發生超賣，且缺乏 workflow-aware 的 GPU 配置。現有系統要麼將 LLM 視為獨立服務（無 workflow 視野），要麼僅以時間維度排程 request，未跨 LLM 聯合分配分數 GPU 資源。

key_innovation.en: Scepsy introduces the Aggregate LLM Pipeline abstraction: from execution traces it extracts per-LLM relative statistics (mean invocations n_m, request-level parallelism p_m) that remain stable across runs, then synthesizes a pipeline-level throughput/latency predictor. A joint scheduler searches over fractional GPU shares, tensor-parallel degrees, and replica counts using the predictor, followed by topology-aware fractional GPU placement on a Kubernetes cluster via NVIDIA MPS.
key_innovation.zh: Scepsy 提出 Aggregate LLM Pipeline 抽象：由執行 trace 萃取每個 LLM 的相對統計量（平均 invocation 數 n_m 與 request-level parallelism p_m），這些量在不同 run 間穩定；再合成 pipeline 層級的 throughput 與 latency 預測器。聯合排程器以該預測器搜尋分數 GPU share、tensor parallel degree 與 replica 數量，並在 Kubernetes 叢集上透過 NVIDIA MPS 進行 topology-aware 的分數 GPU 配置。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.4x higher throughput and 27x lower latency vs systems that optimize LLMs independently or rely on user-specified allocations; on beam search Scepsy attains 2.5x throughput on 4 GPUs and 2.9x on 8 GPUs over Aegaeon, with 3.4x/4.5x latency improvements.
key_improvements.zh: 相較將 LLM 獨立優化或依靠使用者指定資源的系統，throughput 最高提升 2.4x、延遲最高降低 27x；在 beam search 上相較 Aegaeon，4 GPU 與 8 GPU 分別達到 2.5x 與 2.9x throughput，延遲分別改進 3.4x 與 4.5x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX A6000, AMD EPYC 7402P, HBM
gpu_count: 16x NVIDIA RTX A6000 (4 machines x 4 GPUs)
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (paper validates predictor implicitly by scheduler-driven throughput/latency gains rather than reporting MAPE)
models_validated: Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.2-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-PRM, Llama-2-7B, math-shepherd, e5-base-v2
validation_workloads: RAG+reranker, Beam search, combined RAG+beam workload

scope_assumptions.en: Aggregate LLM Pipeline relies on the empirical observation that per-LLM relative execution-time shares are stable across runs even when absolute end-to-end latency varies up to 4x; assumes Kubernetes deployment with NVIDIA MPS enforcing GPU-fraction isolation; topology-aware placement assumes intra-node NVLink and inter-node interconnect, with one vLLM/SGLang replica per LLM and an SGLang router per workflow; non-LLM components (tools, databases) are discarded from the model as their GPU cost is assumed negligible.
scope_assumptions.zh: Aggregate LLM Pipeline 依賴一項經驗觀察：每個 LLM 的相對執行時間佔比在不同 run 之間穩定，即便絕對端到端延遲變異可達 4x；假設 Kubernetes 部署且以 NVIDIA MPS 強制分數 GPU 隔離；topology-aware 配置假設 intra-node NVLink 與 inter-node 互聯，每個 LLM 配一個 vLLM 或 SGLang replica，每條 workflow 配一個 SGLang router；模型刻意忽略非 LLM 組件（工具、資料庫），因為其 GPU 成本被視為可忽略。
